scope: Zombie Boss first-scan protection detail correlation and scan-speed isolation

officialSource.sourceKind: exact official v18 package preserved by the active lifecycle recovery backup

sfsNetwork.result: GetMsgType requires the MsgMap module path and caches the returned table; incoming handling creates an instance from that table and calls HandleMessage

detailMessage.locator: root local _uuid; OnCreate source lines 12-17; HandleMessage 20-30
detailMessage.result: OnCreate overwrites one module-level _uuid upvalue. HandleMessage reuses that same _uuid for the successful response before calling MonsterProtectionManager.OnGetDetail; errors call UIUtil.ShowTipsId instead. Overlapping requests therefore cannot be safely correlated by this message class.

policy: Queue exact MonsterInvasionBossDetail targets and allow only one request in flight.
Hook the exact recovered Net.Msgs.MonsterInvasionBossDetailMessge table so both success and error HandleMessage completion advance the queue.
Only request protection detail when the recovered createTime + monster_invasion.k12*1000 deadline can still be future according to UITimeManager.GetInstance():GetServerTime().
Run the serial queue beside AOI acquisition instead of waiting per AOI.
Remove the previous 100 ms host-side per-AOI protection settle delay.
Do not fabricate protection state for error/unanswered requests.

limits: The owner-visible first-scan Remaining behavior is not yet live-proven after this serialization change.
A request that never reaches the exact message handler can leave optional enrichment partial; base Monster acquisition remains independent and final collection stays bounded.

Manual game interaction that sends the same MonsterInvasionBossDetail command during an owned scan is outside this offline checkpoint and should not be treated as proof of automatic first-scan behavior.
ownerAcceptance: One Normal Monster scan reaches 100% at normal full-world speed without 0.1%-style protection stalls.
A visibly shielded Zombie Boss shows Remaining after the first scan without Jump or manual boss click.
A second scan is not required to prime the timer.
